rules.summary: viewBox must be '0 0 24 24'.
width and height must both be '24'.
root <svg> fill must be 'none'.
every path effective stroke-linecap must be 'round'.
every path effective stroke-linejoin must be 'round'.
stroke-width must never be set explicitly on any element (SVG default 1); inherited widths count.
the fill attribute is omitted on every path (guide: 'Never use fill on any path'); a literal fill attribute, even fill='none', is a syntax-level deviation.
the implementation guide documents stroke '#9747FF' on every path; '#9747FF' passes, any other concrete color is inconsistent with the guide (convention conflict, not a production defect).
whether the runtime CSS mask + currentColor technique neutralizes a hardcoded asset color is a DIFFERENT SCOPE (component usage) that is not tested by this asset-level audit.
icons must be vector only; no raster image content.
the guide describes direct path geometry; transforms are not documented and are surfaced for review.
masks/clip-paths/defs are undocumented structural variants (export artifacts); their presence is surfaced for review rather than passed as whole-structure compliance.
keyshape-first path ordering is described but the guide's own examples contradict it; ordering cannot be auto-verified.
file name is lowercase kebab-case matching <object>[-variant][-modifier] (lexical syntax only).
the guide reserves '--' for dual-state icons (thumbs-up--down); whether a given '--' name is dual-state or an overloaded directional use is a semantic decision, not a lexical pass.
presence of <style> sheets, class selectors, <use> or other references this tool does not evaluate forces a review row; never a false pass.
accessibility (aria-hidden/aria-label) is applied by the consuming component, not the asset; asset-level a11y metadata is a gap.
inner-symbol safe-area insets depend on rendered geometry.
optical alignment/correction requires visual review.
directional/RTL mirroring behavior is undocumented for assets.
corner radius / internal spacing is geometry-dependent.
